Round 346 passes: I found no bugs, and every browser-run check came out as expected. I did not run the gate rows (full vitest, build, Biome, typecheck, `npm run verify`, e2e smoke) and did not claim them. Ableton conformance doesn't apply to this performance change.

| Row | What I measured |
|---|---|
| Claims, scope, read | The claims script matches A's output. The change is exactly the 5 files, and the source patch reverse-applies. The diff only moves the icons into module-level constants, with the same classes and attributes. |
| Unit | `drag-preview-render` passes 66/66, and the four lane/clip suites pass 67/67. |
| Mutants | I broke the code two ways in a scratch copy. With the fold chevron inline again, DP63 failed ("expected 2 to be 0"). With the caption fed committed state, DP64 failed (`film.mp4` still showed mid-drag). |
| Re-render counts, 1440×900 | Components per drag move are now fade 6, trim 18, move 15 (89 at the project-end crossing), and clicks 88 then 0. No fold chevron, grip or `Film` icon re-renders on any fade, trim or non-crossing move. |
| Icon markup | The fold chevron (unfolded and folded), both video-import Plus buttons and the audio grip have identical `outerHTML` to a scratch build of HEAD, at 1440×900 and 1280×720. The `Film` icon is identical on an imported synthetic webm that I generated in the page and kept local. The fold toggle swaps and restores. |
| Production perf (run alone) | 230 rows, 60/60 asserted pass, 0 new rows, and no component or commit count went up. Per move, trim goes 21.633 → 17.7, move 22.8 → 18.467 and fade 9.833 → 5.9. |
| Perf library tests | 40/40 pass, which is the 34 expected plus 6 from `zoom-probe.test.ts`. |
| Auth (fresh anonymous context, both viewports) | `/studio-lab` opens the demo workspace with the demo badge and `auth_user` null. `/studio/<id>` shows "Sign in required" with 0 `audio[src]`. `/api/studio-token` refuses GET with 400 and POST with 405. Premium auth is not bypassed. |
| Docs | Doc 232 line 4 and the single `### ეტაპი c6-i` section are as specified, and the `## ` count is 7. |

- **Crossing and click commits:** the project-end crossing move commit (89) and the click commit (88) still contain library and marker-row chevrons and a Plus icon. A flagged this, and it sits outside stage c6-i, so I judged NAMES on the other commits.
- **Perf duration:** `durationMs` was 455027, just over 450000. That is the known `ROOT-REQ-PERF-TIMEOUT` environment Low, not a failure.

The JSON has `taskStatus` PASS, `browserVerified` and `realVerified` true, `envStatus` copied from `env-status.json`, and empty `bugs` and `blocked`.
